Cabin crew · Germany

Uli Derickson

TWA Flight 8471985
Flight
TWA Flight 847
Date
14 June 1985
Aircraft
Boeing 727
Location
Beirut and Algiers

During the hijacking, the purser used her German to talk with the hijackers, calmed and protected passengers, and paid for fuel in Algiers with her own credit card.

Who helped

  • John Testrake CaptainKept flying the hijacked jet with a gun held on him and persuaded Beirut air traffic control to let the threatened plane land.Sources: 1 2 3 4
